Historical RAW (unfixed) Oberon code-section dumps.
Hex words only; these are not .rsc binaries.

AMemoryMappedToggle.Mod
  git show ddb19e0^:tests/AMemoryMappedToggle.Mod
  Blink3 source: Toggle is light := 1 - light. tools/test_bl_fixup.py
  compiles this file so LightToggle stays at 0x1048.

AMemoryMappedToggle.code
  git show e5743c8:tests/AMemoryMappedToggle.code
  Blink3 unfixed ROM, 18 words. sim/build_pdchain_imem.py plants this
  dump. Do not replace it with the live module.

AMemoryMappedToggle.phase.code
  tests/AMemoryMappedToggle.Mod after ddb19e0: Toggle stores 0 or 1
  from phase, not 1 - light. 29 words. tools/verify_raw_oberon_code.py
  compares the live source to this dump.

Blink3test.code
  rebuilt with tests/Blink3test.Mod maxIterations := 262144
  (ORP emits MHI R0, 4 / 0x60000004 in place of MOV R0, 5)
  includes the imported-call placeholder BL 0xf7102011

Blink2test.code
  git show 073dda5:tests/Blink2test.code
  last unfixed dump of the current tests/Blink2test.Mod source
  (counter := 0; maxIterations := 5). Earlier f3dd680 Blink2.Mod used
  counter := 2 and maxIterations := 16777216, so that dump is a different
  program and is not used here.

Blink2hw.Mod is not in this set: its delay constant changed after the
unfixed-dump era (2^24 -> 262144) so a bit-for-bit match is not expected.
